typeName.description: The target type for authorization information.

action.description: The target action name for authorization information.

user.description:
If specified, authorization will be evaluated for the given user, otherwise all authorization information
that can be applied to the target action specified.

skipDeveloperAndAdmins.description: If true, filter out various admin roles and developer role.

sort.description: If true, sort the results, putting the standard roles (prefixed by `C3.Role`) first.

title:
This spec is used to adjust the results when getting authorization information for an action. Please also see
{@link Authorizer#actionAuthzRoles} and {@link Authorizer#actionAuthorization}
name: ActionAuthorizationSpec
